title: 01 / Approved context
detail: Retrieve permitted sources and preserve the input version.

title: 02 / Generate a candidate
detail: Use the task contract to propose a test or reviewed change.

title: 03 / Enforce authority
detail: Check identity, resource scope and approval before executing a tool.

title: 04 / Verify independently
detail: Run in the sandbox; check stability and relevant fault detection.

title: 05 / Human release decision
detail: Review the evidence through existing CI and change controls.

title: 06 / Learn from the outcome
detail: Retain decisions and effort; curate failures into future evaluations.
